brief:
Yasser Ayad, 16, has emerged as a culinary figure on social media by preparing traditional Palestinian meals in Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. The young chef has garnered attention online for his gourmet cooking videos featuring locally rooted dishes and demonstrating skill in the kitchen despite his age.

Ayad's content represents a cultural expression through food amid the conditions in Gaza, where he continues to document his cooking practice and share recipes with his growing audience across social platforms. His videos showcase preparation of heritage Palestinian cuisine, drawing followers who engage with both the food and the personal narrative behind each meal he prepares.
dek: Yasser Ayad, 16, has become a culinary star on social media as he cooks traiditional Palestinain dishes in Gaza.
title: Gaza teenager Yasser Ayad cooks Palestinian dishes for social media audience
